# Northstar Labs Information Security Policy

Version 3.2. Effective 1 September 2026.

## Account security

Every corporate password must contain at least 16 characters. Passwords must not be reused across corporate and personal services. Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for email, source control, cloud consoles, and the corporate VPN.

Employees must use the company password manager for shared credentials. Shared passwords in chat messages, issue trackers, source code, or personal notes are prohibited.

## Incident reporting

A suspected security incident must be reported within 30 minutes of discovery. Reports must be sent to security@northstar.example and include the affected system, discovery time, and a short description. Employees must not investigate compromised equipment by themselves unless the security team asks them to do so.

Lost laptops and phones with corporate access are treated as security incidents even when remote wipe is enabled.

## Data handling

Confidential documents may be stored only in approved corporate systems. Uploading confidential material to public AI services, personal cloud drives, or public paste services is prohibited.

Access rights are reviewed once per quarter. A manager must request removal of obsolete access no later than the employee's final working day on a project.

## Remote access

Remote access to internal systems requires the corporate VPN. VPN sessions automatically expire after 12 hours and require a new authentication. Public Wi-Fi may be used only while the VPN is active.
